subject.title: bug(agents): nodes tool describe action fails with 'node required' due to schema/implementation mismatch

question: What should omitted `node` mean for the read-only `nodes` tool `describe` action?
rationale: Current schema says omission is valid, current runtime rejects it, and the linked PR's default-node behavior may be different from the list-style discovery behavior proposed in the issue discussion.

options.title: Discovery-safe describe
options.body: Treat omitted `node` as discovery, returning node inventory or using a default only when unambiguous, with regression coverage for single-node and multi-node setups.

options.title: Default-node describe
options.body: Land the linked PR shape so omitted `node` resolves through the existing default-node picker before calling `node.describe`.

options.title: Require node in schema
options.body: Make the schema require `node` for `describe`, accepting that agents must call `status` or list first for discovery.

recommendation.title: Discovery-safe describe
recommendation.body: Treat omitted `node` as discovery, returning node inventory or using a default only when unambiguous, with regression coverage for single-node and multi-node setups.

likelyOwner.reason: The schema flattening and core nodes tool ownership history point to steipete as the best available decision owner for this tool contract.
